title: Paani Ke Andar Dive Karne Wala Hiran! 🦌 #shorts
idea: Exposing the mind-blowing fact that Moose are the only deer that dive up to 5.5 meters underwater to eat plants with self-sealing nostrils.

lines.text: Ek aisa hiran hai jo paani ke andar 5.5 meter gehra dive karta hai!
Moose duniya ka akela aisa hiran hai jo paani ke andar khana khata hai!
5.5 meter gehrai matlab lagbhag ek do manzila imaarat jitna paani mein jaana!
Paani ke pressure se inki naak ke nostrils khud band ho jaate hain!
Ek typical moose har din 32 kg tak khana kha sakta hai!
Kya aapne pehle kabhi kisi hiran ko diving karte dekha hai?

facts.claim: Moose can dive over 5.5 meters underwater to reach plants on lake bottoms.
Moose are the only deer capable of feeding underwater.
Moose nostrils close automatically when exposed to water pressure.
A typical moose can eat up to 32 kg of food per day.
